findings.message: checkout without persist-credentials: false — tokens may leak
findings.remediation: Use persist-credentials: false when checking out external/untrusted repositories.
findings.impact: Checkout without persist-credentials: false leaves GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config for any process to read.
findings.attack_vector: actions/checkout defaults to persist-credentials: true — token leaks via .git/config.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: sensitive GitHub token permissions: security-events:write
findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants write access to a sensitive GITHUB_TOKEN scope.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: modifies shell initialization files
